question: In 2025, who broke the women's mile world record with a time of 4:06.42 at Nike’s Breaking event in Paris?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Faith Kipyegon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Faith Kipyegon** made history in **2025** by breaking the women’s **Mile world record** during a specialized athletic event in **Paris**.
 
• She clocked a remarkable time of **4:06.42**, surpassing the previous world record mark and further cementing her legacy as the greatest middle-distance runner of all time.
 
• The record was set at **Nike’s Breaking event**, an elite competition designed to push the limits of human speed and endurance through optimized conditions and cutting-edge technology.
 
• **Faith Kipyegon**, representing **Kenya**, has consistently dominated the **1500m** and **Mile** distances, holding multiple world records simultaneously across different track categories.
 
• The performance in **Paris** highlighted her exceptional pacing and finish
